title: Frobenius--Cartier duality via lax equalizers
summary: We prove a duality theorem for lax equalizers of stable $\infty$-categories, and we apply it to Frobenius and Cartier modules on a Noetherian $F$-finite scheme $X$ of characteristic $p$ with a unit dualizing complex. When $X$ has affine diagonal, comparison with the derived categories of coherent modules and passage to homotopy categories recovers Baudin's derived Hom duality. The duality of coherent modules exchanges the standard $t$-structure on one side with the perverse $t$-structure determined by the dualizing complex on the other.
